lean.name: Formalism.FrobeniusOrbits.hostThickExists
lean.note: The existence theorem adds a size guarantee to the Behrend construction. For an ambient size $n$ and a coefficient bound $L\ge2$, it supplies a set with $4Ls<n$ for every element $s$, no forbidden three-point relations, and at least $(n/L)\exp(-32\sqrt{\log n\,\log L})$ elements.
